title: Global Graphify ownership and qualified source handoff

statements.text: Reuse the approved context map: dotfiles_ai_distribution in Saltiola7/dotfiles-ai owns global Graphify CLI/dependencies, matching OpenCode skill and update runbook; host_tool_maintenance in Saltiola7/dotfiles removes duplicate declarations and points to that owner. Existing profiles and Product Intent remain authoritative.
Use one native uv tool install owner in dotfiles-ai and one executable version/dependency recipe; no second CLI wrapper or project pyproject.toml/uv.lock ownership.

Bootstrap only a genuinely missing global installation on supported Mac ARM64 with already-installed uv and compatible Python; prohibit Python downloads and preserve excluded default non-Mac, Intel Mac and headless profiles.

Retain a healthy unambiguously owned existing CLI/runtime and its actual version; refresh its matching packaged OpenCode skill. Reapply never requests forced replacement, upgrade, downgrade, reinstall or ownership migration.

Broken executables, ambiguous or orphaned ownership, unresolved runtime roots and missing required modules fail visibly before managed runtime/skill writes; do not create a second environment or silently repair dependencies.

Run the actual runtime's native OpenCode skill installer from private scratch, validate the matching complete packaged bundle, and leave caller/managed repositories free of new project plugins, configuration and hooks; do not rewrite unrelated global OpenCode configuration.

Qualify exact upstream graphifyy 0.9.97 as source/bootstrap candidate with anthropic[vertex], boto3, tree-sitter-hcl, tree-sitter-language-pack==0.11.0 and tree-sitter-sql; honor tree-sitter>=0.25,<0.26 and upstream's prebuilt R/Erlang pack pin.

Before activation, qualify the exact candidate/resolution with isolated metadata, import, AST, native update/query and skill tests plus the existing managed adapter functional contract. Mock or version-only checks cannot substitute for native candidate evidence.

Permit bounded implementation-only dbsctr-project-graphify and focused-test compatibility repair for candidate schema-29/grammar-fingerprint cache identity and native no-change reports; preserve exact CLI, bounded output, provenance/receipts, cache counter meanings, rollback and security contracts. Material normative findings return readiness_reopened.

docs/UPDATES.md owns actual PATH CLI/interpreter/uv receipt-root resolution, active-cycle pins, preserved extra requirements, exact-candidate qualification, separately approved native upgrade, matching skill checks and recovery. The current default uv root may differ; host documentation links rather than duplicates the runbook.

After global source delivery, host source removes the Brewfile graphifyy declaration, run_onchange_install-graphify.sh.tmpl and obsolete interactive_installers.sh comment; add only the focused AI ownership regression, README owner/runbook pointer and host context completion evidence.

Preserve disabled hash-pinned DKS Graphify 0.9.48 and its locks/enablement, existing graphs/caches, active-cycle exact-version commitments and historical evidence; global candidate qualification cannot replace those authorities.
Qualification uses disposable code/Git fixtures only: no provider calls, credential access, paid requests, graph rebuilds in real repositories or DVC pull/push.

Both source slices are elevated-risk, source-only feature-branch draft PR deliveries into configured main; no live apply, installation, upgrade or removal is authorized. Source readiness is never activation consent.
No updater daemon/helper, speculative switches, lifecycle policy/schema changes, uninstall, .chezmoiremove entry, live deletion, environment migration, service operation or arbitrary cleanup.

Prepare global-source as Build-owned ready with complete coordinator docs closure; host-source depends on delivered global-source and stays Discovery-owned discovering; mac-activation depends on both sources and stays Discovery-owned discovering. The primary serializes promotion and delivery.

Direct pins/constraints and uv receipts are not a full transitive hash lock; upstream grammar/cache changes and native updates dropping extra requirements can break adapters. Qualify actual resolved dependencies and retain recovery evidence without weakening contracts.

All kernel, Review/Integrate and Maintain/Retire gates are required; Release/Deploy/Operate are not applicable for profile-bound source-only reasons. Gate results remain pending; primary owns review, publication, Git delivery, manifest validation, fresh receipt/preflight and exact launch approval.

Keep all manifest artifacts source-controlled in the coordinator, including complete changed-document import closure; host profile validation occurs in its home repository. Private paths, host identifiers, credentials and transcripts are excluded. Helpers do not register cycles, stage, commit, push, deploy or own normative changes outside delegated docs.

Live activation remains open until both sources are delivered and exact target/runtime ownership, active-cycle version commitments, preserved preimages, candidate/adapter evidence, checks, recovery and separate exact activation approval are resolved.
